description: Classify whether a small real-coefficient polynomial has all roots strictly in the open left half-plane using an exact Routh table.

contract.definition: For descending coefficients a0,...,an with a0>0, return 1 exactly when every root has strictly negative real part; return 0 for every valid polynomial that is not strictly Hurwitz stable.
contract.degeneracy: A zero first-column pivot or a complete zero Routh row returns 0. No epsilon substitution or row-count interpretation is performed; these cases cannot certify strict left-half-plane stability.
contract.arithmetic: All Routh entries are reduced exact rational values; no floating-point arithmetic is used.
contract.overflow_behavior: The degree is at most four and coefficient magnitudes are at most three. Native fraction-free Routh rows have absolute entries and product intermediates at most 729; the independent determinant oracle uses order at most four, with determinant expansion terms bounded by 4!*3^4=1944. All signed-64 arithmetic is safe.

input.validation_order: Reject null, lengths outside 1..7, non-exact degree-plus-coefficients framing, degree outside 1..4, coefficients outside -3..3, or a nonpositive leading coefficient. A valid polynomial returns 1 for strict stability and 0 otherwise.

output.meaning: 1 for strictly negative root real parts, 0 for a valid polynomial that fails strict stability, and -1 for an invalid frame or coefficient profile.

workspace.accounting: Native implementations use one fixed 5x3 table of signed 64-bit fraction-free Routh row entries (120 bytes), a five-element coefficient array (40 bytes), and scalar temporaries. The 1,024-byte cap covers fixed local state and call bookkeeping. Caller-owned input and ABI metadata are excluded. No heap allocation or variable-sized array is used.

complexity.primary_time: O(degree^2) exact rational updates, with degree at most four
complexity.independent_time: O(degree! * degree) cofactor determinant expansion for all leading principal blocks, with degree at most four
